messages.subject: Airflow Summit 2026 Content FAQ
messages.body:
Hello Airflow community,

*

You are aware that Airflow Summit 2026 is in 6 weeks, but you haven't 
had a chance to fully review and understand the program in order to 
decide if you should attend the conference (or how you will justify it). 
Therefore, we present you with our Airflow Summit 2026 Content FAQ

What is the focus of sessions at Airflow Summit 2026? Who is the target 
audience?

The program is comprised of 3 tracks, each one focused on the needs of 
an audience group:

  *

    Builder Track:For data engineers, DAG authors, DevOps engineers, and
    platform teams who build and operate Apache Airflow ® at scale.

  *

    Data & AI ApplicationTrack: For ML engineers, data scientists, and
    analysts working with data products, ML pipelines, and analytics
    workflows.

  *

    Data StrategyTrack: For managers, directors, and executives making
    decisions about Airflow adoption, team structure, governance,
    observability, and long-term platform planning.

If you identify with any of these, then Airflow Summit 2026 will have 
valuable insights and networking for you.

Will there be any interesting use cases?

Yes! Use cases are a big component of the program 
https://airflowsummit.org/program/. We will have sessions with use cases 
from companies like Capital One, eBay, LinkedIn, Lyft, Liberty Mutual, 
Stripe, Visa, just to name a few.

What about new features and trends in Airflow?

Airflow Summit is THE place to be for learning about the latest features 
of Airflow, directly from the developers themselves. For this edition, 
these are some of the topics that we will cover related to new Airflow 
features:

  *

    Features for providing first-class LLM support in Airflow

  *

    Resumable task execution (ie for long running Spark tasks)

  *

    Multi-language support (ie mixing Java and Python tasks within the
    same DAG)

  *

    Multi-Team Airflow for running multiple teams within a single
    Airflow deployment while providing resource isolation and team-based
    access controls.

  *

    Dynamic graphs for orchestrating agentic workflows with reasoning
    patterns


There is a very good chance that several of this fall within your needs 
and interests. So, come to Airflow Summit and learn all the details, but 
also be involved in the discussions to continue shaping these features.

*
Register here: https://airflowsummit.org/tickets/

-- 
Mara Ruvalcaba
COO, SG Software Guru & Nearshore Link
Cel: 512 627 9549

messages.subject: Re: Airflow Summit 2026 Content FAQ
messages.body:
Excited to meet everyone and hear about your use cases, challenges, and
what you
plan to do (or already are!) with the new features released since last
year's Summit!

See you all!

Thanks & Regards,
Amogh Desai
